acceptance_gate.condition: second-split skip rate within band of persisted 0.56 AND effective AUROC in frozen CI AND accuracy_regression=false AND headline ensemble unchanged
acceptance_gate.principle: The v20 operating point is deployable only if the persisted threshold holds on a disjoint second split without re-tuning.

field_principles.accuracy_regression: BARE bool, must be false for generalization -- the gate trades compute for nothing if it degrades the verdict on the second split.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock plausibility floor; verifier-scoring on a second split is modest.
field_principles.effective_auroc_second_split: The combined fast-path+fallthrough AUROC on the second split -- must stay within the frozen CI [0.9027, 0.9235] for the gate to generalize without regression.
field_principles.headline_ensemble_unchanged: BARE bool, true -- the frozen 0.9131 full-scoring ensemble is the fall-through and is UNTOUCHED; the gate is additive.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; the robustness outcome; blocked_<resource> if a precondition failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached scores + the persisted predictor + operating point, no live model).
field_principles.is_measurement_not_retrain: BARE bool, true -- confirms v21 MEASURES the persisted operating point (does not retrain or re-tune) -- the lineage-continuation forward difference.
field_principles.model_specs: Names the corpus + 4 verifiers + the Tier-3 predictor -- honest substrate.
field_principles.operating_point_generalizes: BARE bool -- whether the v20 operating point holds out-of-sample (skip within band AND no AUROC regression); false is a valid finding (needs per-split recalibration).
field_principles.skip_rate_second_split: The skip rate of the persisted gate on the SECOND held-out split -- the out-of-sample generalization evidence vs v20's 0.56.
field_principles.three_split_sizes: Sample-size + leakage hygiene -- the predictor-training split, the v20 measurement split, and the v21 second split are all disjoint.
field_principles.v20_operating_point_threshold: The persisted v20 threshold T reused UNCHANGED -- confirms v21 measures, it does not re-tune.

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached scores + the persisted predictor + operating point, no live model).

methodology.fixed_threshold_source: Exp 3803 persisted operating point, reused unchanged
methodology.predictor_api: FR11ExtendedJEPA.predict loaded from persisted v19 state
methodology.second_split: different seed, original FoVer row IDs disjoint from v19 train and v20 measurement

preconditions_checked.detail: online graph fit, graph learner, and fixed crossfit baseline importable
